guitar.guitaristsText: Dave Murray / Adrian Smith / Janick Gers
guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (Murray & Smith signature models) / Gibson Les Paul (Gers)
guitar.evidence: Dave Murray and Adrian Smith both have Fender Stratocaster signature models; well documented for a 3-guitarist lineup.

tone.target: bright galloping Marshall crunch with twin-lead bite
tone.profile: bright galloping Marshall crunch with twin-lead bite
tone.summary: A tight, high-gain signal chain utilizing a Boost/OD for attack, followed by an AC30 TB amp model paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cab to achieve the required bright, galloping crunch and lead bite.

rig.name: Iron Maiden - Phantom Of The Opera - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain passages and tight palm-muting.
Increase attack and upper-mid punch for the 'galloping' feel.
blocks.gap: None (Used to simulate a boost pedal)

blocks.purpose: Provide tight, aggressive crunch and bite without excessive fuzz.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style is a good proxy for the mid-focused grit of Plexi/Marshall, but may lack true Marshall saturation.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British Marshall sound (Plexi) required for NWOBHM.
Provide the classic British cabinet tone and required punch.
Enhance the upper mids and brightness for lead bite and separation.
Placeholder for potential lead sweeps (optional). Kept off to maintain punchy rhythm tone.
blocks.gap: Not strictly necessary for the core sound, but included as a versatile option.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and separation for the twin-lead passages without sounding muddy.
blocks.gap: The requirement is 'dry and punchy,' so delay must be kept minimal.

blocks.purpose: Provide minimal natural room ambience without heavy reverb.
blocks.gap: The 'dry' requirement limits the use of any large reverb, but a touch of Room helps glue the sound.

blocks.purpose: Allows the player to boost volume/gain for lead sections or maintain consistent output.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for increased mid-range bite and vintage Marshall cabinet realism.

proposals.reason: Enhance Plexi/Marshall character and upper-mid punch for NWOBHM bite.
